findings.description: Group Resize, keyboard and direct property paths missing shared min/max/aspect checks
Protected/grouped child could preview detached geometry and retain invalid relationship; prior nesting not checked
Every reactive Region ran after any watched object edit; unrelated locked/invalid Region blocked valid layout
Property handler scheduled Text Flow after commit failure; coalesced property save lacked rollback
Planner/preview did not share raw bounds/stroke checks; multi-page delete bypassed generic guard
Repeated ancestry/subtree scans in resolved scene and commit; replace with scoped graph indexes
Overflow page creation lacked structural history and style staleness guard; central style editing could race batch
Font evidence accepted any loaded face in matching family without matching style/weight

limits: Source review of changed paths only, not exhaustive proof of all editor callers
Explicit geometry edits may remain when a reactive plan is invalid; no partial automatic layout; diagnostics and runtime acceptance pending
Nested Region rigid in parent planner; cross-project style batch not automatic
Exact glyph coverage/font rendering, storage durability, performance and runtime all NOT_RUN
